Game Overview

In Insect Intruders, the core idea is straightforward: defend your tree as a daring guardian in Insect Intruders. Engage in strategic, nostalgic top-down shooting action by hurling leaves at relentless bug invaders. Master timing, utilize destructible shields smartly, and stay vigilant against diverse enemies in this vibrant, challenging adventure.
